correctness.rationale: For degree<=d, each radius-t intensity U_t has Laurent Fourier modes -d..d. A 2d-point angular DFT recovers every c_m(t), |m|<d, without alias; the sole mode d combines A=a_d conj(a_0) and conj(A). The aligned and delta-rotated rings yield Re A and Re(exp(id delta)A), a 2x2 matrix with determinant -sin(d delta). If nonzero, both entire circle intensity trigonometric polynomials are known. The rational quotient of two polynomials with equal moduli on circles of distinct radii is invariant under a nonunit dilation and hence unimodular constant, including vanishing-coefficient cases. If sin(d delta)=0, 1+i z^d and 1-i z^d collide. Eigenvalues 1+/-|cos(d delta)| of B^T B give the exact best half-step Nyquist coefficient conditioning; this is not global polynomial inverse stability. All quantifiers and the d=1 boundary are valid.
